justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent initially struggled to confirm the date and then offered an earlier time than requested, but eventually found a suitable slot.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent did not proactively offer alternatives when the initial request was unavailable, instead asking the user to suggest new times.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeatedly asked the user to confirm the date and repeated the same unavailable slot multiple times, leading to unnecessary turns.
justifications.customer_experience: The repeated questions and lack of proactive suggestions made the conversation feel frustrating and inefficient for the customer.

judge_scores.overall_notes: The agent struggled with basic conversational flow and temporal understanding, leading to a poor customer experience despite eventually booking an appointment.
